name: information-theory
description: Use this skill when the user says 'entropy', 'cross-entropy loss', 'KL divergence', 'perplexity', 'bits per byte', 'mutual information', 'compression is prediction', 'manifold hypothesis', 'intrinsic dimension', 'ELBO'. Explains the information-theoretic quantities behind ML training and evaluation and applies them: interpreting losses and perplexity, KL in distillation/RLHF/VAEs, calibration, and measuring intrinsic dimension of embeddings. Do NOT use for: diffusion/score-based generative math (fundamental-truths/statistical-mechanics), classical statistics and hypothesis tests (data-science/statistical-analysis), or embedding search systems (ai/llm-engineering/rag-architecture).
